references.text: The command to honor father and mother is given in the Ten Commandments, which form the basis for many of Jesus' references to the Law in the New Testament.
This verse contains part of the law stating that anyone who curses their father or mother must die, which underscores the seriousness of failing to honor one's parents.
This verse repeats the law that anyone who curses their father or mother must die, showing the continuity of the Law throughout the books of Moses.
